detailed_scope_append_proposed: Include the explicit full-enumeration studentized two-sample U permutation-test algorithm with recomputation of both variance estimates and tie handling. The tie-corrected Wilcoxon specialization uses h(x,y)=1{y>x}-1{y<x}, its probabilistic-index weak null, positive direct and pooled projections, and empirical row/column projection variances whose true-sampling and joint permutation consistency are proved locally. Atoms and heterogeneous laws are allowed; equality of means or medians alone is not the null.
